verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly confirm plugins are MCP-based: "Plugins use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose server-backed capabilities to ChatGPT and Codex" (docs-33), plugins can be "a remote MCP-only plugin" (docs-40), and installed plugins "add skills and MCP tools to new chats" (docs-26), with tooling like `/plugins`, marketplace add, and plugin-creator scaffolding MCP wiring (docs-11, docs-15, docs-25). Community commentary references using/building MCP servers alongside Codex without disputing this capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of installing a third-party/custom MCP server and using its tools end-to-end, and broader detail on non-curated MCP server support.
